title: Shadow Deployment Diff Report
hints: Classify each request with the first rule that matches: shadow_error, exact, normalized, numeric, mismatch.
Exact means the canonical JSON is identical. In Python, 1 == 1.0 and True == 1 are both True, so == is not that test.
bool is a subclass of int. Exclude it explicitly before treating a value as a number.
Shadow errors are not disagreements. Leave them out of the agreement denominator and gate them with their own error-rate limit.
